in_marathi.name: Sharbhavya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity and Blessings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharbhavya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharbhavya is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharbh' which means 'abundance' and 'Bhavya' which means 'prosperity' or 'auspicious'. The name Sharbhavya is often used to invoke the blessings of the Goddess of Prosperity and Wealth, Lakshmi. It signifies the abundance and blessings that one receives in life.
